PROP-api-request-inv-013.text: Each generation must map to exactly one Discord role (unique key constraint).
PROP-api-request-inv-013.assertion: forall g1, g2: g1.generation == g2.generation => g1.discord_role_id == g2.discord_role_id

locations.note: Checks existing role before creating; uniqueness enforced in code but relies on application-level check, not just DB constraint
Also guards against duplicate creation; but race condition possible — no DB-level unique constraint visible
